Code Review ✅ Approved 🟡 Medium risk Marshaling isou chat requests changes encoding for prompts and model names; a serialization regression could alter what the API receives. Switches the isou provider's chat request body from `fmt.Sprintf` to `json.Marshal` so prompts containing quotes, backslashes, or newlines are sent as valid JSON. The fields sent to `https://isou.chat/api/chat` are unchanged, and the new tests cover escaping in both the prompt and the model name. No issues found.

Does isou even work anymore? I am getting Gateway time-out Error code 504 on their website

Good question. I just checked from here: the isou.chat front page returns 200, but a real chat request (the same body this provider sends: model, provider, language, categories, engine, messages) got no response at all within 90 s on two attempts, so it looks like the backend is timing out, consistent with the 504 you see. A malformed body gets an immediate 400 (`"engine" is required`), so the API layer is up and the generation/search backend is what hangs.

That is independent of this PR: it only changes how the body is encoded (json.Marshal instead of Sprintf, so quotes/newlines in the prompt don't produce invalid JSON), with identical fields. If isou stays down for a while, I'm happy to follow up with a separate PR removing the provider, or to leave this as is, whichever you prefer.

---
Disclosure: this comment was drafted with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude); the probe results above come from requests it ran.
